newsitem.title: UK: NWE JET SPOT BARGES TRADE STEADY, CARGOES LISTLESS.
newsitem.headline: NWE JET SPOT BARGES TRADE STEADY, CARGOES LISTLESS.

text.p: Northwest European jet fuel changed hands at steady values on Wednesday but cargoes were inactive, traders said.
Outright values eased. September IPE last traded 75 cents easier at $169.75 a tonne in lethargic trade.
A 2,000 tonne barge was bought by an airline at September IPE +$18 fob Rotterdam for second half August, unchanged from Tuesday. A small piece was rumoured done at September +$18.50.
Cargoes were inactive, assessed at September +$16.50/$17.00 cif NWE. Med European quality was around Med fob high +$7.
